title: SPEAK INTO YOUR DAY BEFORE THE ENEMY DOES
text: Glory to God. Glory to Jesus. Somebody lift up your voice and worship the Lord right now. I said worship him. Hallelujah. You know the spirit of the Lord dropped something in my spirit. And I want you to hear me very carefully this morning. There is a dimension of spiritual authority that many believers have not yet accessed. We live in a world where voices are competing for attention. Where powers and principalities are speaking into atmospheres. Where the enemy of our souls wakes up every morning with an agenda to define, to limit, to restrict, and to abort the purposes of God in the lives of men. But I come to announce to you tonight that there is a superior voice. There is a voice that carries creative power. There is a voice that commands reality. There is a voice that shifts atmospheres. And that voice has been given to you as a believer. The Bible says in John chapter 1, in the beginning was the word and the word was with God and the word was God. Everything you see in the physical realm began as a word in the spiritual realm. God spoke and walls came into existence. He said, "Let there be light." And light appeared. He spoke to chaos and brought order. He spoke to emptiness and brought fullness. The entire universe is a product of the spoken word of God. And then the Bible says that same word became flesh and dwelt among us. Jesus Christ is the incarnate word of God. And when he died and rose again, he deputized that authority to speak to you and to me. Now watch this very carefully. The Bible says that the devil is a liar and the father of lies. Jesus said in John 8:44, "When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own. for he is a liar and the father of it. Now I want you to understand the strategic implication of this statement. Satan does not have creative power. He cannot create anything. But what he has mastered is the ability to suggest, to insinuate, to whisper, to project, to paint pictures in the minds of men. Every morning the kingdom of darkness convince meetings. There are satanic conferences happening in the realm of the spirit where your name is mentioned, where strategies are designed against your destiny, where limitations are programmed, where fears are manufactured, where doubts are packaged and released into the atmosphere to intercept your faith. And this is what many believers do not understand. The first voice that speaks into your day carries a certain measure of authority to define the trajectory of that day. If you wake up and the first thing you do is reach for your phone and begin to scroll through bad news, through reports of disaster, through images of tragedy, through narratives of lack and limitation, you have given the enemy the permission to frame your consciousness, you have allowed the voice of fear to be the first voice that speaks. If you wake up and the first thought that floods your mind is worry about your finances, anxiety about your health, dread about your circumstances, you have yielded the microphone of your morning to the spirit of heaviness. But glory to God, there is a better way. There is a protocol of the kingdom. There is a spiritual technology that the early church understood. They knew that the morning hours were sacred. They knew that the first moments of consciousness were critical. They knew that whoever speaks first into your day, has the capacity to set the tone, to establish the frequency, to determine the atmosphere. This is why David said in Psalm 5:3, "My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, oh Lord. In the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and we look up." David understood that the morning was not just another time of day. The morning was a strategic moment, a prophetic gateway, a door of opportunity to align your spirit with the voice of heaven before the voice of hell could get access. I need you to hear this in your spirit. You are not a victim. You are not at the mercy of circumstances. You are not a passive observer in the unfolding of your destiny. You are a prophetic voice. You are a priestly authority. You are a royal decree carrier. God has placed within you the same spirit that raised Christ from the dead. The Bible says in Romans 8:11, "If the spirit of him that raised up Jesus from the dead dwell in you, he that raised up Christ from the dead shall also quicken your mortal bodies by his spirit that dwelleth in you." That means you have resurrection power on the inside of you. You have lifegiving power. You have deathdefeating power. You have the capacity to speak to death situations and command them to leave. Now I want to take you to the book of Genesis. When God wanted to create man, the Bible says in Genesis 1:26, "And God said, let us make man in our image after our likeness." I want you to catch this. God did not say, "Let us make a creature." He said, "Let us make man in our image." The Hebrew word for image is celm which means a representative figure a replica a shadow that carries the substance of the original. God was saying I want to make someone who will function like me who will operate like me who will speak like me who will create like me who will command like me. And then he said after our likeness, the word likeness is demove Hebrew which speaks of resemblance in nature in character in manner of operation. So when God created man he created a being who was designed to function as his representative on the earth to carry his voice to speak his words to decree his will. This is why after creating Adam, God brought all the animals to him and said, "Whatever you call them, that shall be their name." God was establishing a principle. The one who names a thing has authority over that thing. The one who speaks to a thing first has the right to define that thing. Adam was not just giving cute pet names to animals. He was exercising dominion. He was demonstrating the power of prophetic declaration. He was showing that man created in the image of God has the capacity to name to define to establish reality through the spoken word. But then sin entered and when sin entered man lost that confidence. Adam hid from God. He became afraid. He became conscious of his nakedness. He lost the boldness to speak. He lost the authority to decree. He became a victim instead of a victim. And from that moment, human beings have been struggling to recover their voice, struggling to recover their confidence, struggling to recover their authority to speak to creation and command obedience. But glory to God, Jesus came. The second Adam came. The Bible says in 1 Corinthians 15:45, "The first man, Adam, was made a living soul. The last Adam was made a quickening spirit. Jesus came to restore everything that was lost in the fall. He came to give us back our voice. He came to restore our authority. He came to deputize us with the power to speak and see results. This is why Jesus said in Mark 11:23, "Whosoever shall say unto this mountain, "Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea, and shall not doubt in his heart, but shall believe that those things which he saith shall come to pass, he shall have whatsoever he saith." I need you to catch the repetition in that verse. Jesus said, "Whosoever shall say shall not doubt in his heart, but shall believe that those things which he said shall come to pass. He shall have whatsoever he say." Three times Jesus emphasized the power of saying. Three times he pointed to the spoken word because Jesus understood that faith without corresponding declaration is incomplete. You can believe all you want in your heart, but until you give voice to that belief, until you articulate that faith, until you decree that word, it remains in the realm of potential. It must be spoken to become kinetic. Now, this is where many believers miss it. They wake up in the morning and they are spiritually silent. They are prayerless. They are wordless. They stumble out of bed and rush into their day without taking authority, without speaking to their day, without commanding their atmosphere, without decreeing the word of the Lord over their lives. And then they wonder why they experience so much turbulence, so much confusion, so much frustration. It is because they have left the door of their day open for the enemy to walk in and set the agenda. Listen to me very carefully. The enemy does not sleep. First Peter 5:8 says, "Be sober, be vigilant, because your adversary, the devil, as a roaring lion walketh about, seeking whom he may devour." The devil is walking about. He's roaming. He's seeking. He's looking for access points. He's looking for unguarded moments. He's looking for people who are spiritually careless, who are prayerlessly passive, who are decreeing nothing, declaring nothing, speaking nothing. And when he finds such people, he pounces. He injects thoughts. He plants suggestions. He releases fears. He activates anxieties. And before you know it, your entire day is hijacked by a spirit that you never invited or that you permitted to your silence. This is why the Bible says in Ephesians 6:18, "Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the spirit and watching there unonto with all perseverance and supplication for all saints." The instruction is to pray always, not occasionally, not when you feel like it, not when things are going wrong, but always because the spiritual realm is active 24 hours a day. Demons do not take holidays. Principalities do not go on vacation. There are powers in the air that are perpetually busy, perpetually plotting, perpetually scheming. And if you are not perpetually praying, you are perpetually vulnerable. Now, I want to show you something about the morning in scripture. In Exodus 34, when Moses went up to Mount Si to meet with God, the Bible says in verse four, "And Moses rose up early in the morning and went up onto Mount Si as the Lord had commanded him early in the morning." Why? Because Moses understood that there is something about the morning hours that makes them uniquely conducive to divine encounter. There is a freshness in the morning. There is a clarity in the morning. There is a silence in the morning before the noise of the world begins to compete for your attention. In the morning, your spirit is still tender, still sensitive, still receptive. This is the time to give God your faithfulness, not your left. This is the time to speak to your day before the enemy does. In the book of Isaiah 50:4, the Bible says, "The Lord God had given me the tongue of the learned, that I should know how to speak a word in season to him that is weary. He wakenth morning by morning, he awakened my ear to hear as the learned. Morning by morning, this was the rhythm of the prophets. Morning by morning, they tuned their ears to heaven. Morning by morning, they positioned themselves to hear from God. Morning by morning they spoke what they heard. They understood that the voice of God in the morning would sustain them through the battles of the day. And I prophesy to somebody here, you are entering a season where you will become morning by morning conscious. You will become early rising. You will become dawn seeking. There will be a hunger in your spirit that will wake you up before your alarm clock. There will be a staring in your soul that will pull you out of bed while the world is still asleep. And in those sacred hours, in those secret moments, in those divine encounters, God will download strategies, God will release revelation. God will impart authority. And you will speak into your day with a power and a precision that will make demons tremble. Let me tell you what happens when you speak into your day before the enemy does. Number one, you establish the atmosphere. The Bible says in 2 Corinthians 10:4, "For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strongholds." When you wake up and you begin to decree the word of God, when you begin to declare the promises of God, when you begin to speak in tongues, when you begin to sing praises, you are pulling down demonic strongholds, you are dismantling satanic architectures, you are collapsing evil altars, you are establishing a heavenly atmosphere over your life that the enemy cannot penetrate. When you speak first, you set the frequency. You set the tone. You set the standard. You are saying, "Devil, you have no right here. Sickness, you have no place here. Poverty, you have no permission here. Fear, you are not welcome here. This is a day that the Lord has made. I will rejoice and be glad in it. This day belongs to God. This day is sanctified. This day is anointed. This day is favored. And I decree by the authority of the name of Jesus that every plan of the enemy against this day is cancelled, is nullified, is overturned, is destroyed. Number two, you activate angelic assistance. The Bible says in Psalm 103:20, "Bless the Lord, ye his angels that excel in strength, that do his commandments, hearkening unto the voice of his word." Did you catch that? Angels hearken unto the voice of his word. Not unto the voice of your complaints, not unto the voice of your fears, not unto the voice of your doubts, but unto the voice of his word. When you wake up and you begin to speak the word of God, you are giving angels something to respond to. You are activating them. You are commissioning them. You are releasing them into operation on your behalf. This is why it is critical that you speak scriptures, not just opinions. You can have all kinds of positive thoughts, but if those thoughts are not rooted in the word of God, angels have nothing to enforce. Angels enforce the word of God, not your good intentions. So when you wake up and you say, "The Lord is my shepherd. I shall not want. He makes me to lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters. He restores my soul." You are not just reciting poetry. You are releasing a divine decree that angels are obligated to enforce. You are speaking the language of heaven and heaven responds to its own language. Number three, you align your faith. The Bible says in Romans 10:17, faith cometh by hearing and hearing by the word of God. When you speak the word of God out loud in the morning, you are not just speaking to your circumstances. You are also speaking to yourself. You are building your own faith. You are reinforcing your own confidence. You are reminding your soul of who God is and what he has promised. Your ears are hearing. Your mouth speak the word of God. And faith is rising. Doubt is falling. Fear is breaking. Confidence is building. By the time you step out of your house, you are not stepping out as a timid, uncertain, fearful person. You are stepping out as a lion. You are stepping out as a king. You are stepping out as a conqueror. You are stepping out as more than a conqueror through him who loves you. Number four, you frustrate the plans of the enemy. There is something the enemy does not want you to know. He's terrified of your voice. He's afraid of your decrees. He's intimidated by your declarations. This is why he works overtime to keep you silent, to keep you distracted, to keep you busy, to keep you prayerless. because he knows that if you ever discover the power of prophetic declaration, if you ever tap into the authority of decreeing the word of God, if you ever begin to speak into your day before he does, his assignments will fail. His strategies will collapse. His plans will be frustrated. In the book of Job 5:12, the Bible says he disappointed the devices of the crafty so that their hands cannot perform their enterprise. When you decree the word of God, you are releasing a force that disappoints the devices of the crafty. You are releasing a power that frustrates the plans of the enemy. You are speaking something that has the capacity to stop the hand of the adversary from performing his enterprise. This is not religious talk. This is spiritual reality. This is kingdom protocol. This is the way God designed things to work. Now, let me take you deeper. In the book of Proverbs 18:21, the Bible says, "Death and life are in the power of the tongue, and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof." Did you hear what the spirit of God just said? Death and life, not just good and bad. Not just positive and negative, but death and life. Your tongue has the capacity to release life or to release death. Your words have the capacity to build or to destroy. Your decrees have the capacity to bless or to curse. And the Bible says, "They that love it shall eat the fruit thereof." You will eat the fruit of your words. You will experience the consequences of your declarations. You will live in the reality that your mouth has created. This is why you cannot afford to be careless with your words. You cannot afford to speak negatively about yourself. You cannot afford to cost your day. You cannot afford to prophesy disaster. You cannot afford to agree with the enemy's narrative because every word you speak is a seed and every seed produces after its kind. If you speak death, you will eat death. If you speak life, you will eat life. If you speak poverty, you will experience poverty. If you speak abundance, you will experience abundance. If you speak sickness, you will experience sickness. If you speak health, you will experience health. And this is what the enemy knows. He knows that he cannot just attack you randomly. He needs your cooperation. He needs your agreement. He needs your words. This is why he sends thoughts, suggestions, imaginations, fears. He's trying to get you to speak what he's thinking. He's trying to get you to vocalize his agenda. He's trying to get you to prophesy his plans. And if he succeeds, if he gets you to say, "I will never make it. I will never succeed. I will never be healed. I will never be delivered. I will never be free. Then he has legal permission to enforce what you have spoken. Because you have given him your voice. You have become his prophet. You have become his mouthpiece. But glory to God, you can reverse this. You can take back your voice. You can take back your authority. You can take back your power to speak. And this morning, right now, I prophesy over your life. Your voice is coming back. Your confidence is coming back. Your boldness is coming back. Your authority is coming back. You will no longer be silent. You will no longer be passive. You will no longer be a victim of circumstances. You will speak to your day. You will speak to your week. You will speak to your month. You will speak to your year. You will speak to your destiny. And when you speak, heaven will respond. Angels will move. Demons will flee. and the will of God will be established in your life in the mighty name of Jesus. Now I want to give you a practical protocol. This is how you speak into your day before the enemy does. Number one, wake up with thanksgiving. The Bible says in Psalm 100 verse4, enter into his gates with thanksgiving and into his courts with praise. Before you ask for anything, before you present any petition, before you make any request, enter with thanksgiving. wake up and say, "Thank you, Lord, for life. Thank you for breath. Thank you for health. Thank you for strength. Thank you for another opportunity. Thank you for mercy. Thank you for grace. Thank you that I'm alive to see this day. Thank you that your mercies are new every morning. Thank you that your faithfulness is great." When you start with thanksgiving, you are positioning your heart. You are tuning your spirit. You are adjusting your frequency. Thanksgiving is the key that unlocks the gates of heaven. Thanksgiving is the language that heaven responds to. Thanksgiving is the attitude that attracts the presence of God. And when you begin your day with thanksgiving, you are already winning. You are already ahead. You are already in the place of victory. Number two, worship the Lord. Worship is not just singing. Worship is a posture of submission. Worship is an acknowledgment of God's sovereignty. Worship is a declaration of God's supremacy. When you worship, you are saying, "God, you are greater than my problem. You are bigger than my situation. You are higher than my circumstance. You are the most high God. You are the almighty. You are the allsufficient one. You are El Shadai. You are Jehovah Gyra. You are Jehovah Rafa. You are Jehovah Nissi. You are the Lord my banner. You are the Lord my healer. You are the Lord my provider." When you worship, you are magnifying God and minimizing the enemy. You are enlarging your perspective of God and shrinking your perspective of the problem. Number three, decree the word of God. Open your mouth and speak scriptures. Speak promises. Speak covenants. Say, "I am the head and not the tail. I am above only and not beneath. I am blessed in the city and blessed in the field. Blessed is the fruit of my body, the fruit of my ground, the fruit of my cattle. The Lord will command a blessing upon my storehouse and in all that I set my hand unto the Lord will open unto me his good treasure the heaven to give the rain unto my land in his season and to bless all the work of my hand. No weapon that is formed against me shall prosper. Every tongue that rises against me in judgment I shall condemn. This is my heritage as a servant of the Lord. My righteousness is of the Lord. When you decree the word like this, you are not begging, you are not pleading, you are not hoping, you are declaring, you are announcing, you are establishing, you are commanding reality to align with the word of God. You are speaking as one having authority. You are functioning as a king. You are operating as a priest. You are carrying out your mandate as a believer. Number four, pray in the Holy Ghost. The Bible says in Jude verse 20, "But ye beloved, building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Ghost." When you pray in tongues, you are praying the perfect will of God. You are praying mysteries. You are praying secrets. You are praying things that your natural mind does not comprehend, but that your spirit knows are necessary. When you pray in the Holy Ghost in the morning, you are building a hedge of protection around yourself. You are fortifying your spirit. You are sharpening your spiritual sensitivity. You are tuning your discernment. You are activating your spiritual gifts. And I want to tell you something. Demons hates the sound of tongues. Demons are confused by the sound of tongues. Demons are intimidated by the sound of tongues. Because when you speak in tongues, they cannot decode what you are saying. They cannot understand what you are decreeing. They cannot decipher what you are releasing. All they know is that something powerful is happening in the spirit realm and they must flee. Number five, make prophetic declarations over specific areas of your life. Do not just pray generally. Be specific. Speak to your health. Say, "Body, I command you to function according to divine design. Every organ, every cell, every tissue, every system, I command you to align with the word of God. I decree that I am healed by the stripes of Jesus. I decree that long life and good health are my portion. I decree that I will live and not die. I will declare the works of the Lord. Speak to your finances. Say, I decree that the windows of heaven are open over my life. I decree that there is no lack in my life. I decree that my God supplies all my need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus. I decree that I am a lender and not a borrower. I decree that wealth and riches are in my house. I decree that the wealth of the sinner is laid up for me. Speak to your family. Say, I decree that as for me and my house, we will serve the Lord. I decree that my children are taught of the Lord and great is their peace. I decree that my marriage is blessed. I decree that my home is a heaven of peace, a sanctuary of love, a fortress of faith. Speak to your business. Say, I decree that my business prospers. I decree that favor surrounds me as a shield. I decree that divine ideas flow into my mind. I decree that strategic connections come my way. I decree that every door I need to open opens. Every door I need to close closes. I decree that I'm walking in divine alignment, divine timing, divine favor. Speak to your day. Say, I decree that this is a good day. This is a blessed day. This is a favor day. This is a victorious day. I will encounter divine appointments. Today I will experience divine interventions. Today I will walk in divine protection. Today I will operate in divine wisdom. Today I will manifest divine grace. Today angels are going before me to prepare my way. The Holy Spirit is in me to guide me. The blood of Jesus is over me to protect me. No evil shall befall me. No plague shall come near my dwelling. For he has given his angels charge over me to keep me in all my ways. This is how you speak into your day before the enemy does. This is how you take charge of your atmosphere. This is how you exercise your authority. This is how you function as the king and priest that God has called you to be. Now, let me close with this. In the book of Revelation 12 11, the Bible gives us the formula for overcoming the enemy. It says, "And they overcame him by the blood of the lamb and by the word of their testimony, and they love not their lives unto the death." Three things, the blood of the lamb, the word of their testimony, and their willingness to die for their faith. But I want you to focus on the second one, the word of their testimony. They overcame by the word. Not by silence, not by passivity, not by hoping, but by the word. By speaking, by testifying, by declaring, by decreeing. The enemy is defeated by your voice. The enemy is conquered by your confession. The enemy is destroyed by your declaration. This is why you must speak. This is why you must decree. This is why you must prophesy. This is why you must take authority. Because your voice is a weapon. Your voice is a sword. Your voice is a hammer. Your voice is a fire. Your voice is a storm. Your voice is a force that the kingdom of darkness cannot withstand. And so I want to lead you in prayer right now. I want you to open your mouth wherever you are. I want you to lift up your voice. I want you to speak into your day. I want you to take authority over your atmosphere. I want you to decree the word of the Lord. I want you to prophesy into your future. Are you ready? Let's go. Father, in the name of Jesus, I thank you for your word. I thank you for the authority you have given me. I thank you that I am created in your image and after your likeness. I thank you that I have the capacity to speak and see results. I thank you that my voice carries power. I thank you that my words carry weight in the realm of the spirit. And right now, in the name of Jesus, I speak to this day. I decree that this day is blessed. This day is favored. This day is anointed. This day is sanctified. This day belongs to the Lord. I cancel every assignment of the enemy against this day. I nullify every plan of darkness. I destroy every satanic agenda. I pull down every stronghold. I dismantle every demonic architecture. I collapse every evil altar that has been raised against me. I decree that no weapon formed against me shall prosper. Every tongue that rises against me in judgment I condemn. I decree that I am hidden under the shadow of the Almighty. I decree that the angels of the Lord are encamped around me. I decree that the fire of God surrounds me. I decree that the blood of Jesus covers me. I decree that I am untouchable. I am unreachable. I am inaccessible to the forces of darkness. I speak to my health. I command every sickness to leave my body now. I command every disease to dry up from the roots. I command every infirmity to be destroyed. I decree that I am healed. I am whole. I am strong. I am healthy. I am vibrant. By the stripes of Jesus, I am healed. I speak to my finances. I command the windows of heaven to open. I command abundance to flow. I command supernatural provision. I command divine opportunities. I command uncommon favor. I decree that I am blessed. I am prosperous. I am increasing. I am multiplying. The wealth of the sinner is laid up for me. I speak to my family. I command peace in my home. I command love in my relationships. I command unity among my family members. I command salvation for my household. I command divine protection over my children. I command blessing over my spouse. As for me and my house, we will serve the Lord. I speak to my destiny. I command every door that should be open to open now. I command every door that should be closed to close now. I command divine alignment. I command divine timing. I command divine connections. I command strategic relationships. I command the right people to find me. I command the wrong people to leave me. I decree that I'm walking in my purpose. I am fulfilling my assignment. I am completing my mandate. I am finishing my course. I speak to this week. I decree that this is a week of breakthrough. This is a week of miracles. This is a week of acceleration. This is a week of multiplication. This is a week of divine encounters. This is a week of answered prayers. This is a week of manifestation. This is a week of victory. I speak to this month. I decree that this month is blessed. This month is anointed. This month is favored. This month I will experience the goodness of God. This month I will see the salvation of the Lord. This month I will walk in divine health. This month I will walk in divine prosperity. This month I will walk in divine peace. I speak to this year. I decree that this is my year. This is my season. This is my time. This year everything that concerns me shall prosper. This year I am moving from glory to glory. This year I am going from strength to strength. This year I am rising higher. This year I am going deeper. This year I am enlarging my territory. This year I am expanding my influence. This year I am increasing my impact. And I decree that from this day forward I will wake up every morning and speak into my day before the enemy does. I will take charge of my atmosphere. I will exercise my authority. I will decree the word of God. I will prophesy my future. I will not be silent. I will not be passive. I will not be a victim. I am a voice. I am a king. I am a priest. I am a prophet. I am a warrior. I am a conqueror. I am more than a conqueror through Christ who loves me. It is done. It is settled. It is established in the mighty, powerful, undefeable, unbeatable, incomparable, matchless, glorious name of Jesus Christ. Amen. Hallelujah. Glory to God. Somebody shout hallelujah. Give God praise. Give him glory. Give him honor. He's worthy. He's faithful. He's true. And his word will not return unto him void. It shall accomplish what he pleases. It shall prosper in the thing whereto he sent it. Your day is blessed. Your week is blessed. Your month is blessed. Your year is blessed. Your life is blessed in Jesus mighty name.
